description: Partner pack for Monad — parallel-execution EVM L1 with 10k TPS, 1s block time, bytecode-compatible. Biases toward high-throughput DeFi, real-time games on-chain, and latency-sensitive agents.

defaults.headline: Ship on Monad — 10k TPS parallel EVM
defaults.subheadline: Bytecode-compatible with Ethereum; tuned for high-throughput DeFi, on-chain games, and low-latency agent flows.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions Monad, parallel EVM, or high-TPS DeFi that would stress Ethereum mainnet.
firstSteps: Configure the chainId (testnet: 10143) and rpcUrl (testnet: https://testnet-rpc.monad.xyz) in partner-config.json — use devnet for local work, testnet for integrations.
For forge-contracts / hardhat-contracts: add the Monad RPC as a network entry and deploy with the usual toolchain — no Monad-specific compiler flags.
For evm-infra-ts: default to 1s block-time polling; Monad produces blocks 12× faster than Ethereum mainnet so tune indexer cadence accordingly.
gotchas: Monad is NOT an OP-stack or zk rollup — it's a parallel-execution L1. Don't assume OP proofs, rollup withdrawal windows, or L1 settlement patterns apply.
Transaction ordering semantics differ from serial-execution chains; avoid assumptions that tx A settled before tx B just because A was submitted first unless you check block ordering.
